newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LAZIO'S ZOFF ESCAPES INJURY IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAZIO'S ZOFF ESCAPES INJURY IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: Lazio president Dino Zoff escaped unhurt on Monday after his car was written off in a high-speed motorway collision, the Italian serie A club said.
Zoff's car came to rest against a guard rail after rolling over twice in the accident.
The former Italian national goalkeeper was returning to Rome after attending the funeral in the northern town of Vercelli of former World Cup winning player Silvio Piola, who died last week.
